entries.name: Quartermaster
entries.summary: Star Fleet Tours' self-hosted tour-operator booking and operations application: launch-viewing mission/trip products, dated trips with check-in, boarding and departure times plus per-boat and per-ticket-type capacity, and passenger bookings tracked from draft through confirmed, checked-in, completed or cancelled with payments, refunds, QR tickets and manifests.

license_review.rationale: The repository-root LICENSE snapshot (sha256 f095247d5a085c7fb80fd76de8280ffcb268cc330a16d4889dcb2c48cbb50f5c, 630 lines / 32,433 bytes) is byte-identical to the current master file and to the file introduced by the only LICENSE commit (2f8baf2); a fresh re-fetch on 2026-10-29 returned the same digest. The upstream file itself ends inside the AGPL-3.0 appendix 'How to Apply These Terms to Your New Programs', at line 630 with '...the "copyright" line and a pointer to where the full notice is found.'; the remainder of the sample notice and the remote-network source-offer guidance are not present upstream. Sections 0-17 and 'END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS' are present, and GitHub's repository page and the README both identify the project as AGPL-3.0, so the SPDX identification is AGPL-3.0. The snapshot is nevertheless not a complete copy of the license text; the missing appendix tail is an upstream omission rather than a capture truncation.

features: Mission, launch and trip catalog with launch-viewing and pre-launch trip types
Dated trips with sales windows and check-in, boarding and departure times
Per-boat and per-ticket-type capacity and pricing
Public multi-step booking flow with Stripe payment
Booking lifecycle from draft to confirmed, checked-in, completed or cancelled
Payment and refund states attached to bookings and booking items
Admin dashboard for bookings, trips, fleet, reports and CSV passenger manifests
QR tickets, passenger check-in and refund processing
deployment: Self-hosted Docker Compose stack with PostgreSQL, FastAPI and React
Optional Traefik reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS

leaf_matches.reason: Quartermaster is the booking and management system used by Star Fleet Tours for its own launch-viewing trips. Missions and trip types form the operator's reusable trip catalog; Trip rows are dated, capacity-bearing departures with sales windows and check-in, boarding and departure times; Booking rows carry the lead passenger's name, email, phone and billing details plus prices, payments, refunds and a draft→confirmed→checked_in→completed/cancelled lifecycle, while BookingItem rows carry ticket/merchandise quantity, price and refund state (no separate per-traveller table is present in the snapshot). The README also documents the public booking flow, admin dashboard, QR check-in and passenger manifests.

entries.name: Voyant
entries.summary: Managed travel-commerce back office for tour operators, agencies and DMCs, covering a tour/package catalog, departures and availability, bookings and participants, payments, supplier costs and finance.

leaf_matches.reason: The official homepage addresses tour operators, travel agencies and DMCs and shows a back office with products, bookings, departures, clients, suppliers and finance, including dated departures with capacity/status and a quote→booking→payment→travel→close flow. The documentation describes catalog products, departures and availability, the full booking lifecycle, and finance attached to bookings.
